note: Diagnostic, not a hyperparameter axis. trial-038 (batch=128, zero reg) is the sweep's best (0.5891 @ epoch 7), but its val_loss oscillates rather than declining cleanly (0.5902->0.5922->0.5891->0.5923->0.5939->0.5948 across epochs 5-10) - a symptom of only ~94 optimizer steps/epoch making each epoch's estimate noisier. Before treating 0.5891 as a real result worth building the next round on, this reruns the exact same config with a different seed (123 instead of 42) to see if a ~0.589 minimum is reproducible or was a lucky low epoch.

1st required regularization trial. trial-039 tested dropout=0.1/wd=0.1 on top of batch=128 and did slightly worse than trial-038's zero regularization (0.5900 vs 0.5891) - the opposite direction from batch=8, where the same 0.1/0.1 beat zero regularization (trial-041 0.5914 vs trial-031 0.5918). This tests whether batch=128 simply wants a lighter regularization optimum than batch=8's (0.05/0.05, half of trial-039's), rather than concluding regularization doesn't help at this batch size.

Further maps the batch-size curve between trial-040 (batch=64, 0.5905) and trial-038 (batch=128, 0.5891, best of the sweep) to see if the trend keeps improving toward 128 or has already peaked somewhere in between.
